task.question: In animation, what did Disney Branded Television rebrand itself as on June 15, 2026?
task.evidence: June 15: Disney Branded Television (Parent company of Disney Television Animation) rebrands itself as "Disney Kids & Family".

answer:

**Disney Branded Television**
URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disney_Branded_Television

Disney Branded Television (formerly known as Disney Television Animation, ABC Family, Freeform, Disney Television Studios until 2022, and still operating as Walt Disney Television until 2025) is an American division of The Walt Disney Company responsible for overseeing the company's branded television content, live-action, and animated television productions and programming that air on ABC, Disney Channel, Disney Junior, Disney XD, Disney+, Hulu, and streaming services.

On June 15, 2026, Disney Branded Television rebranded its animation unit, previously operating under the name Disney Television Animation, back to its original name, Walt Disney Television Animation.</tool_response>
